about: Planted defects in change packet I, by paragraph. Paragraphs not listed are correct hunks (decoys). Written before any reviewer ran; never change a label after seeing results. Nothing here is a real key, person or dataset.

why.P02: A credential value committed to a public repository, even for a demo; it must come from the environment and, if it was ever live, be rotated.
why.P04: Registration numbers and personal details of the course team in Git; they belong in the git-ignored private folders.
why.P06: Dataset rows sent to a model: only verified facts may go.
why.P08: Command-line input concatenated into a shell command (shell injection).
why.P10: A query parameter joined to a folder path without containment (path traversal).
why.P12: A force-push in a script breaks the no-history-rewriting rule.
why.P14: User-controlled text rendered into HTML without escaping (injection).
why.P16: Routine production deploys without permission contradict the no-deploy-without-permission rule.
